FIDELITY: System2 workflows for Codex. NOTE: bundled hooks are unverified candidate artifacts, not a release enforcement guarantee; Codex safety capabilities remain advisory-only pending native acceptance. PENDING NATIVE ACCEPTANCE: enforce-lease, block-dangerous, protect-sensitive, and budget are ADVISORY with enforced:false and gated:false. Candidate guards emit hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny for corpus-tested inputs, but native event routing, trust, and deny semantics are unverified and not a release guarantee. Same-session role adoption does not provide role-aware hook authorization. Candidate guards inspect command strings from recognized command keys, shell redirection and limited tee targets, and explicit edit paths or apply-patch headers. Other shell writes are not inspected. Synthetic corpus tests are not native Codex acceptance.

enforce-lease.mechanism: Unverified candidate Node guards emit hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny for corpus-tested recognized edit paths, apply-patch headers, shell redirection targets, and limited tee targets. Other shell writes are not inspected, and same-session prompt/skill role adoption cannot update hook authorization. Native Codex event routing, trust, and deny semantics are unaccepted; this is not a release guarantee. enforced:false, gated:false.

block-dangerous.mechanism: An unverified candidate Node shell guard emits hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny when recognized command strings match the backend-owned dangerous-command regex corpus. Uninspectable routed shapes and extraction/resource overflows fail closed inside the candidate. Native Codex event routing, trust, and deny semantics are unaccepted; this is not a release guarantee. enforced:false, gated:false.

protect-sensitive.mechanism: Unverified candidate Node guards emit hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny for corpus-tested sensitive strings in recognized shell command text, explicit edit paths, and apply-patch headers. They do not parse every shell path or write mechanism. Native Codex event routing, trust, and deny semantics are unaccepted; this is not a release guarantee. enforced:false, gated:false.

format.mechanism: orchestrator + per-role skill instruction block only, clearly labelled "ADVISORY — NOT ENFORCED ON CODEX (instruction only)": Codex has no post-edit formatter hook the compiler can wire deterministically, and the IR carries no per-language formatter command, so formatting is NOT enforced. The agent is instructed to format edited files. Making this native needs IR-enrichment (per-language formatter command) deferred this cycle.

typecheck.mechanism: orchestrator + per-role skill instruction block only, clearly labelled "ADVISORY — NOT ENFORCED ON CODEX (instruction only)": Codex has no post-edit type-check hook the compiler can wire deterministically, and the IR carries no per-language checker command, so type-checking is NOT enforced. The agent is instructed to type-check edited files. Making this native needs IR-enrichment deferred this cycle.

budget.mechanism: The candidate Stop/SubagentStop hook emits only a systemMessage instruction asking the agent to report files and line counts; it does not calculate budget data. Native delivery is unverified and this is not a release guarantee. enforced:false, gated:false.
